p22Evidence.substance: host/deploy/secret_file_runner.mjs validates a mounted --config-file and --database-url-file pair fail-closed, rewrites only its own in-process process.argv and delegates to the existing audited host runner, so the credential value is never an OS-visible argument, never read from the environment and never disclosed by a refusal

host/deploy/Dockerfile builds the artifact from three digest-pinned multiarch bases with a lock-only npm ci production install, a hash-locked uvicorn 0.40.0 set and an offline-built host wheel, behind a deny-first build-context fence, and execs the P22A1 wrapper as a numeric non-root user on two mounted secret-file paths

one command stands up a digest-pinned PostgreSQL 16.15 at migration head 0003_policy_decision_log under the mfk_migration / mfk_runtime NOBYPASSRLS role split, starts the unchanged P22A2 image beside it under --read-only, --cap-drop ALL and no-new-privileges with no published port, answers real HTTP from its own installed Uvicorn inside an isolated network, and proves the mounted credential reaches none of six observable surfaces

a real POST /customers over a real socket to the live listener inside the frozen image commits through the unchanged audited boundary and answers 201 with a COMMITTED CommitReceipt bound to exactly one customer_records, one audit_log and one transactional_outbox row, the authorizing decision is the independently recomputed genesis of the tenant's hash-chained policy_decision_log, and a foreign-tenant claim is refused 403 CROSS_TENANT_DENY with no business row written

p22Residuals: the proven environment is ephemeral and deletes itself: both containers, the database volume, the isolated network, the per-run image tag and the temporary host secret directory are removed before the run exits
no staging environment exists and no staging run was performed; an ephemeral environment that deletes itself is neither
no registry is contacted, authenticated against, tagged for or pushed to; the image exists only in a local build cache under a per-run tag
no external deployment, no promotion and no production host selection; nothing here makes the artifact deployable, releasable or production-ready
proven once, sequentially: no restart, durability, concurrency, sustained-load or noisy-neighbor proof, and no monitoring
the verification reads run as the database superuser and bypass row-level security, so they are not the application's own read path
no authentication, session, token or credential check anywhere in the path; the identity headers are claims a test process makes and the trusted principal is a mounted config file
the audit is still opt-in and default-off (--audit on)
Docker is a hard requirement, so the proof reruns only where a daemon exists
digest pins freeze security updates along with versions, and amd64 and arm64 are different artifacts whose output digests are not byte-reproducible between rebuilds
the credential still lives as a host file mount: mount permissions, rotation and the storage backing that mount are deployment-time responsibilities outside this package
no orchestration, ingress/TLS/DNS/load balancer, no secret store, no rollout or rollback drill (that is P23) and no Actionplan node writeback for this closure
honestTension: P22 is named deploy package/staging and no staging environment exists. P22 closes on what was actually delivered and test-verified — a deployable artifact (P22A1's secret-file argv boundary, P22A2's input-pinned OCI image) plus a proven live run of that exact frozen artifact (P22B1's ephemeral live HTTP against real migrated PostgreSQL, P22B2's live audited business write and cross-tenant refusal) — with the absent persistent staging environment carried forward as the leading named P22 residual. This is the P21 precedent applied unchanged: P21 (security) closed while the audit stayed opt-in, no DAST existed and the scan was not a required merge check.
